status: LOOP FACTOR ON THE ICOSAHEDRAL MODULE at the closed clock g = 0.785398, cell (2,2,2), step dimension 128, ladder n <= 12 on the momentum grids [12, 16, 24, 32]. (T1) closed words of length n on the module's six-axis lattice against the cubic three-axis one, closed form verified against brute-force walk counts up to n = 12: n = 2: 12 / 6, n = 4: 396 / 90, n = 6: 19920 / 1860, n = 8: 1281420 / 44730, n = 10: 96807312 / 1172556; the count ratio at n = 6, 8, 10 is 10.7, 28.6, 82.6 against 2^n = 64, 256, 1024: the module offers 12 choices per step against the cubic 6, so the path algebra is 2^n larger, and the closed-word ratio falls short of 2^n by the return-law prefactor. (T2) the dynamical return amplitude F_n = < tr M(q)^n >: the cubic control is exact on its trapezoid (the grids agree to 4.8e-14); the icosahedral box mean is resolution-limited at every measured length - largest relative change of F_n between grids finer than n+1, on the fixed box |q| <= 12.5664: n=2: 3.9e-01, n=4: 1.1e+00, n=6: 1.4e+00, n=8: 1.1e+00, n=10: 2.0e+00, n=12: 1.3e+00; no length is resolved at the 0.05 level (drift from 0.24 at n = 2 up to 2.0 at its worst, a factor 8.4). The six axes have irrational images in Q(sqrt 5), so tr M(q)^n is almost periodic: no finite grid is a projector, and box convergence is not established either. (T3) the ratio F_n(icosahedral)/F_n(cubic) at the finest grid: axes (0, 1, 2) [-24.0867, 5.0517]; axes (0, 2, 4) [-0.3659, 1.7296]; over the resolved lengths the within-triple spread is not measurable and the typical value not measurable; over the unresolved lengths it swings by a relative 1.21 and is not quotable. (T4) the cubic control's box mean falls below the loop scale 1/(16 pi) = 0.019894 at n = 3 on its exact grid, while the module's stays above it at every measured length ({(0, 1, 2): None, (0, 2, 4): None}); the log-log slopes of |F_n| are cubic -1.3879 (r2 0.9998) over n = 4..12, the module over its resolved lengths not measurable (r2 not measurable), not measurable (r2 not measurable), and over all measured lengths 0.3584 (r2 0.1114), -2.5126 (r2 0.7896) - the mean is of the trace, with sign cancellation, so none of these is the closed-walk n^-3/2 census slope of T1.. NOT MEASURED, and it is the named residual: the published n* = 208 and the coefficient 2.710 (2.699-2.700 on the float64 ladder) live on V203's traced-link Cartan-norm estimator, not on this return amplitude; resolving the box mean at n = 208 would need a grid of order 4n per axis, (832)**3 = 5.8e+08 diagonalisations of a 128-dimensional step. What the module move does to the loop factor is therefore measured exactly in its combinatorial half (the closed-word count, 2^n), while its dynamical half is bounded by resolution: any shift of n* is outside what this instrument can see.
